measurement_basis: Projected background-local units at the fixed mansion camera; not physical inches or source-image pixels.

instance_measurement_contract.size_profile_id: Profile key above; independent of orientation ID.

size_measurements.floor_reference: Local [x,y] floor point directly below the seat center, not an arbitrary front leg or approach anchor.
size_measurements.seat_contact: Local [x,y] pelvis contact at the seat surface; match the interaction anchor.
size_measurements.seat_width: Visible usable width, excluding chair arms.
size_measurements.seat_depth: Projected usable depth; side/front views require visual calibration.
size_measurements.footrest_contact: Local [x,y] or null; required for stool foot alignment.

rules: All orientations share a profile; projection changes the silhouette, not intended physical size.
Measure seat rise as floor_reference.y minus seat_contact.y. Do not infer it from full artwork bounds.
Targets are initial art-direction estimates, not proof of existing furniture or pose fit.
Do not stretch actors or independently normalize seated images to standing height.
Do not resize annotation rectangles to pretend baked furniture has changed.
Zoom and source resolution changes scale the whole scene uniformly.
Unknown or incompatible contacts remain unavailable for automatic staging until calibrated.
